string.text: A professor from the science complex at Lake Yantar asks for two strong gravitational artifacts in order to establish a business relationship with him.
A request from the leader of Clear Sky

"You ever heard of the Sinners? Totally badass dudes. Rumor has it they're holed up in the Hills somewhere near Radar. The leader's not even human. He was one of the first stalkers in the Zone. In short, it's one of the oldest groups in the Zone, they've been here since before all this happened. So, I know that at their base, there on the Hills, there is a building with various documents. Anyway, there's something I need. One folder of documents. Maybe you can get it?"
Find documents at the Sin group's base
Bring the documents to the leader of Clear Sky

The scientist at the science complex at Yantar refuses to let me into the Professor's bunker because of some personal problem. His wife disappeared in a lab under the Dark Valley. He clearly he wants the pendant that he said he gave her? Do I go looking for that pendant, or do I send that asshole back there?
Find the silver pendant in the laboratory beneath the Dark Valley.
Bring the pendant to the scientist
